policies.text: Standard healthcare endorsement is conferred on diagnostic equipment with an operating battery lifespan of at least 24 hours.
Fast-tracked authorization for market entry is granted when a medical device producer maintains active ISO 13485 certification.
First-level sales partnership designation is awarded to hardware whose annual maintenance revenue reaches at least 400000 USD.
Inclusion on the top-tier drug roster requires a treatment device to achieve an efficacy rate exceeding 80 percent.
Reimbursement authorization is granted to therapeutic tools maintaining an overall patient satisfaction rating above 90 percent.
